name: The man at the helm of the inflatable, sentenced in May 2025 (silhouette only)
depiction: Bruce Knowles, 55, of Dereham, Norfolk, who pleaded guilty at Ipswich Crown Court to being concerned in importing cocaine and was jailed for 17 years and 3 months in May 2025. Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette: no face, no features, no identifying clothing; a plain dark work jacket. Not a likeness. Tagged NOT A LIKENESS. No family member is drawn or named.
